mapper.insert: INSERT INTO email_verifications (email, verification_code, expires_at, verified, created_at) VALUES (#{email}, #{verificationCode}, #{expiresAt}, #{verified}, #{createdAt}) ON CONFLICT (email) DO UPDATE SET verification_code = #{verificationCode}, expires_at = #{expiresAt}, verified = #{verified}, created_at = #{createdAt}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM email_verifications WHERE email = #{email} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE email_verifications SET verified = #{verified} WHERE email = #{email}
